minurso-mission-ends-western-sahara-2026.headline: The UN mission in Western Sahara is over, and with no monitors on the ground, tension between Morocco, Algeria and the Polisario could grow.

quick.happened: The UN mission MINURSO ends after 35 years; reports say the Security Council failed to extend its mandate amid a US-Russia standoff.
quick.matters: The UN warns of security risks, and tension between Morocco, Algeria and the Polisario could affect regional security and migration towards Spain.
quick.next: The mission enters a liquidation phase; one outlet reports its head called an emergency meeting on it, and the UN says it stands ready to support peace efforts.

minurso-mission-ends-western-sahara-2026.text: Nothing material is new since the summary. Reports on the mission's end repeat the UN's warning of security risks and its statement that it stands ready to keep supporting peace efforts.

quick.happened: The UN peacekeeping mission MINURSO in disputed Western Sahara has ended after 35 years, and the UN warns of security risks.
quick.matters: Without monitors, tension between Morocco, Algeria and the Polisario could rise, which could affect regional security and migration towards Spain.
